Object_Note: نکات نگهداشت تجهیز در زمانیکه خارج از سرویس می باشد Measures to be taken during stop periods When the stop periods are longer than one day: • Switch on the oil supply system daily for at least five minutes. • Protect the Vorecon against ingress of water and humidity. Preserve bright parts accordingly. • Start the Vorecon every 1-2 months for a short time. Do not run it warm (risk of condensation water).  preservation of spare parts:شرایط نگهداری قطعات یدکی در انبار Every one to four weeks • Check the pressure on the pressure gauge. Setpoint 0.1 bar. • In case of a pressure drop on the pressure gauge to 0.05 bar- re-establish the preservation overpressure of 0.1 bar • Preserve runner parts/ connecting coupling using nitrogen. • Check the transport container for external damages and corrosion- repair the painting- if necessary Annually • Open the vent valve at the transport container (check the pressure inside the container at the pressure gauge). • Remove the cover and check the stored parts for corrosion. • Check the sealing surfaces of container and cover. They must be metallically bright. • Seal the sealing surface again using sealing compound (Hylomar) and Teflon cord and tighten the cover. • Re-establish the preservation overpressure of 0.1 bar
